name: Oxfam America
mission:
Oxfam is a global organization that fights inequality to end poverty and injustice. We offer lifesaving
support in times of crisis and advocate for economic justice, gender equality, and climate action. We
demand equal rights and equal treatment so that everyone can thrive, not just survive. The future is
equal.
theoryOfChange: Oxfam America has a published 'Oxfam America 2030 Strategy Framework' which outlines their core aspirations for the next decade and is complemented by three-year plans. This strategy was developed through a comprehensive and inclusive process, grounded in evidence, and future-oriented. It details how Oxfam America aims to collaborate and innovate on a global scale, shifting resources and power to marginalized people. Additionally, Oxfam America has piloted a 'Corporate Inequality Framework (CIF)' to help investors analyze how companies contribute to inequality, assessing corporations across four pillars: People, Power, Profits, and Planet, using 78 indicators.

dimension_explanations.alignment: This organization focuses on urgent humanitarian causes and has a long track record of success in fields like petroleum governance and resilient livelihoods [4][6]. It offers a medium fit for Muslim donors seeking to give sadaqah toward global poverty relief [10].

The organization provides strong evidence of its outcomes, such as resolving job disputes and influencing new labor laws [9]. In FY2025, it maintained a moderate Program expense ratio of 72.3%, meaning a significant portion of funds goes to its mission [11].

strengths_deep_dive: Oxfam America achieves high third-party ratings, highlighted by its <cite id="1">96/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite>. Its long history since 1942 supports extensive global field operations that deliver tangible results, including documented success in <cite id="3">climate-smart agriculture adoption</cite> and empowering women in local decision-making [3][4]. Additionally, financial efficiency in development remains notable, with <cite id="1">fundraising costs kept to $0.19 per $1 raised</cite>.
rich_narrative.summary: Founded in 1942, Oxfam America works to alleviate global poverty through direct aid, long-term community development, and policy advocacy. In FY2025, the organization reported <cite id="11">$75,339,434 in total revenue</cite>, which reflects a decline from the $83,115,051 recorded in FY2024 [11]. Demonstrating strong organizational health, Oxfam America maintains <cite id="1">a 96/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite>. Its programming serves millions of individuals worldwide across several core initiative areas, including <cite id="3">climate-smart agriculture adoption</cite> and emergency humanitarian relief [3]. While operations are effective, the organization's <cite id="1">72.3% program expense ratio score</cite> sits below the peer-group median of 90.0% for humanitarian groups [1]. Donors seeking to fund international development can support these initiatives through sadaqah or general donations [10].
